mechanism: Donepezil (cholinesterase inhibitor) enhances acetylcholine effects which may counteract haloperidol's anticholinergic properties and increase extrapyramidal side effects; both drugs can prolong QT interval.
action: Monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias, and syncope; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower extrapyramidal risk; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
